meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把模糊想法问成一份可照做的开发计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望在动手写代码前先得到一个清晰、完整、可执行的实施步骤。
copy.tagline_en: Turn vague ideas into an actionable development plan before coding.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear, executable plan before writing any code.

howto.what: 你要求先规划再编码时,它会进入“规划模式”:先只读探查代码库,必要时做研究或向你提问;等你明确同意后,才在 .omo/plans/ 下写出一份含任务清单和“不做”清单的工作计划。它不会改产品代码,执行需单独发起。
howto.when: 只有你明确要求“先规划后编码”的流程(比如说 “ulw-plan”“make a plan”“break this down” 等)才会触发;它不会自己启动,只说运行 ulw 不算请求。

say.text: ulw-plan: 先把 /login 的限流改动做成一份实施计划
say.note: 进入计划模式,先探索;你说同意后才会写计划。

say.text: make a plan: 把认证模块的重构拆成步骤,先别写代码
say.note: 意图不透彻时它会先研究,必要时才问你。

say.text: plan this: 为新功能列一份执行任务清单,标出不要做哪些
say.note: 产出计划后,你仍可让它调整;同意后另发指令才开始执行。

howto.what_en: On explicit request to plan before coding, it enters plan mode: read-only exploration of the codebase, research or questions as needed, then after your approval writes ONE work plan under .omo/plans/ (tasks + don'ts). It never edits code; execution starts separately.
howto.when_en: Only when you yourself explicitly ask for the ulw-plan workflow, e.g. 'ulw-plan', 'make a plan', 'break this down', or similar wording. Never self-activates; a bare ulw run is not a request.

say_en.text: ulw-plan: make an implementation plan for the /login rate-limit change.
say_en.note: Enters plan mode, explores first, waits for your ok.

say_en.text: make a plan: break the auth module refactor into steps, don't code yet.
say_en.note: If intent is unclear, it researches and adopts defaults first.

say_en.text: plan this: give me an execution task checklist and mark what not to do.
say_en.note: You can ask for edits later; approval only starts execution.
